Mangalore Central Railway Station and the State Bank city bus stand are both within walking distance, City Centre Mall on KS Rao Road is the everyday shopping stop, and Milagres Church and Wenlock District Hospital sit on the edge of the locality. Attavar lies immediately to the south-east, Kodialbail up the hill to the north and Bolar towards the old port.
